trait_recovery.statement: per-dimension r(theta_hat, theta_true) >= 0.8 on all 8 dimensions, held-out personas

item_recovery.statement: median per-item r(fitted, designed loadings) >= 0.7 on held-out items

blur_honesty.statement: pooled +/-1 blur coverage of planted theta inside 60-75%

weak_item_ordering.statement: designed-weak items come out with low fitted discrimination
weak_item_ordering.value_label: chance that a random designed-weak item has lower fitted discrimination than a random strong primary
weak_item_ordering.bar: median weak discrimination below the 5th percentile of strong primaries
weak_item_ordering.caveat: PREREGISTRATION section 6 states this check qualitatively ('designed weak items must show low fitted discrimination'); the rule above is this grader's reading of it, not a frozen number. The two distributions are reported in full so the call can be re-made.

alignment.method: orthogonal Procrustes, fitted on the 400 training personas, applied unchanged to held-out

diagnostics.note: a ratio above 1 means the fitted model is more confident than it has earned; the multiplier is how much wider the interval would have to be to reach the nominal 68 percent

blur_honesty_unpinned_metric.note: what the coverage would have been on the unpinned joint-MAP scale, where the latent unit is set by the ridge rather than by the prior

reliability_ceiling.reading: reliability well above the observed correlation means the estimate is repeatable but is tracking something that is not exactly the planted value -- the shortfall is in what the answers carry, not in how noisily they were read

answer_matrix_ceiling.scope: held-out personas, training items only -- the exact cells the fit saw
answer_matrix_ceiling.reading: this is what the answer matrix itself carries; a fitted recovery that lands at or above these numbers has extracted what is there

weak_item_ordering.pass_rule: median weak discrimination below the 5th percentile of strong primaries

distractors.verdict: LEAKAGE HUNT: distractors carrying real discrimination, listed above

q229.flag: SIGN FLIPPED against the designed direction

q234.flag: SIGN FLIPPED against the designed direction

latent_metric.note: latent variance pinned at the prior's value of 1 (point-estimate spread + mean posterior variance); likelihood and all correlations are unchanged
